from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperReference(BaseModel):
    """A single paper citation found within the text of a document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the paper cited in the bibliography")

class DocumentPaper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper processed by the parser, containing its own title and references found."""
    paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper as identified in the document")
    references: list[PaperReference] = Field(description="List of paper titles found in this document's reference section")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extraction for one document processed by the parser."""
    papers: list[DocumentPaper] = Field(description="List containing the extracted information for the current document")
